# SEO audit (Marketing Skills)

Diagnoses technical, on-page and content SEO problems and gives a prioritized fix list.

- Source: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills/main/skills/seo-audit/SKILL.md
- Author: Corey Haines
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/seo-audit-marketing-skills-856aa15d

Used when a site isn't ranking or traffic has dropped. Claude works through technical SEO (crawling, indexing, speed, Core Web Vitals), on-page factors, content quality, international and local SEO, and common issues by site type, then reports findings in priority order. Reference files and evals are bundled. Works best with access to the site and Search Console data.

**Try asking:**
- "Why isn't my site ranking? Do an SEO audit"
- "Our traffic dropped after the Google update, help"
- "Review title tags and meta descriptions on these pages"
